title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-24 01:09:42 最新章节：第161章 是兄弟就来砍我
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
“师尊，我……”
“轰隆隆……”
宁楚刚张口，头顶乌云汇集，一道闪电划破天空，仿佛只要她把剩下的话说完，天雷就会直接劈到她头上。
听着滚滚闷雷，再看眼前男人清冷绝尘的脸，原本要说的话堵在喉头，她长叹一口气。
鹤隐舟扶手而立，一双如琥珀般明亮的眼眸淡然扫过她的脸，冷漠道：“何事？”
有天雷虎视眈眈地在宁楚头顶盯着，她再也说不出表白的话，摇了摇头，“没事，突然想起今天的早课还没做，我先走了，师尊再见。”
说罢，她提着裙摆转身就跑，身影很快消失在鹤隐舟面前。
宁楚不是这个世界的人，她是个病秧子，药石无医，死后穿越到浮生界，还绑定了个攻略系统。
系统说，只要她能拿下修无情道的高岭之花鹤隐舟，就能百病全消，得到五千万回到自己原本的世界潇洒。
她想活，她磨刀霍霍。
但她没想到她穿越的身份是天剑宗宗主的女儿，宗主宠爱她，让她拜了鹤隐舟为师。
修仙界有天道法则压制，不允许欺师灭祖，更别提生出不.伦之情。
只要她对师尊不敬，天雷就劈她，后来甚至有一团乌云随时随地跟着她。
故她穿来一百八十八年，天剑宗真千金都找了回来，她从真千金变假千金，万人迷变万人嫌，修为突破到了元婴后期，还没完成自己的攻略任务。
她真的累了，她不想干了。
“统统，你有没有什么办法能够暂时遮蔽天道法则？”
【系统：宿主，你想做什么？】
因为长时间获取不到能量，系统的电子音听起来多了几分活人的虚弱感。
“我想最后再试一次。”她从储物袋里掏出一个药瓶，里面装的是合欢宗圣药。
只需要一滴，即便是没有心的石头也能中招。

这还是她之前去合欢宗当交换生时别人送她的，她一直没敢用。
【系统：可以是可以，但你确定吗？】
宁楚紧紧地握着手里的药瓶，眼神坚定中透着愚蠢，“我确定。”
不然等到师尊无情道飞升了她还完不成攻略任务。
【系统：那行吧。】
夜凉如水。
宁楚端着一壶灵花饮进了鹤隐舟的洞府，他修炼的洞府跟他这个人一样冷冰冰的，没有一点家的感觉。
听见脚步声，坐在桌前看书的鹤隐舟连头都没抬，修长食指微动，书页无风而动。
“师尊。”宁楚开口，将托盘放在桌上，倒出一杯灵花饮捧到他面前，“徒儿亲自酿的灵花饮，加了数百种灵果，很是香甜，您尝尝。”
鹤隐舟这才抬眸，面无表情地看她一眼，又低下头，薄唇轻启：“不必，本尊不爱甜食，你出去吧。”
她捏着瓷杯的手一紧，心中忿忿地想，三十七度的嘴怎么能吐出如此冰冷的话，真是伤透了她的心。
但她不想放弃，又把杯子往他唇边递了递，可怜巴巴道：“师尊，您就尝尝吧。”
“这是一百八十八年前您教我酿的第一坛灵花饮，您知道的，徒儿是假千金，宗门上下都不喜欢我，没人愿意和我交朋友。”
“唯一能和徒儿说两句话的只有师尊您了，难道您也讨厌我了吗？”
content_en:
"Master, I..."
"Rumble..."
Just as Ning Chu opened her mouth, dark clouds gathered above her head, and a bolt of lightning pierced the sky, as if as long as she finished the rest of her words, thunder would hit her head directly.
Listening to the muffled thunder, and looking at the cold and pure face of the man in front of her, the words she originally wanted to say were stuck in her throat, and she let out a long sigh.
He Yinzhou stood on the armrest, a pair of eyes as bright as amber swept across her face indifferently, and said indifferently: "What's the matter?"
One day, Tian Lei stared at Ning Chu's head with eager eyes. She could no longer express her feelings and shook her head, "It's okay. I suddenly remembered that I haven't finished my morning classes today. I'll leave first. See you, Master."
After saying that, she turned around and ran away while holding up her skirt, and her figure quickly disappeared in front of He Yinzhou.
Ning Chu is not from this world. She is a sick girl with no cure. After death, she traveled to the floating world and was bound to a strategy system.
The system said that as long as she could take the Heyinzhou, the flower of the high mountain that cultivates the ruthless path, all her illnesses would be cured, and she would get 50 million to return to her original world.
She wants to live, and she sharpens her knife.
But she didn't expect that the identity she traveled through time was the daughter of the sect leader of the Tianjian Sect. The sect leader doted on her and asked her to become He Yinzhou's disciple.
The world of cultivating immortals is suppressed by the laws of heaven, and it is not allowed to deceive the master and destroy the ancestors, let alone develop unethical feelings.
As long as she was disrespectful to her master, thunder would strike her. Later, there would even be a dark cloud following her anytime and anywhere.
Therefore, she traveled back one hundred and eighty-eight years and found all the real daughters of the Tianjian Sect. She changed from a real daughter to a fake daughter, and became a millionaire's favorite. Her cultivation level broke through to the late Nascent Soul stage, but she has not yet completed her strategy mission.
She was really tired and didn't want to do it anymore.
"Anyway, is there any way you can temporarily obscure the laws of heaven?"
[System: Host, what do you want to do? 】
Because it cannot obtain energy for a long time, the electronic sound of the system sounds a bit more frail than a living person.
"I want to try it one last time." She took out a medicine bottle from her storage bag, which contained the holy medicine of the Hehuan Sect.
All it takes is one drop, and even a stone without a heart can be struck.
This was given to her when she was an exchange student in Hehuan Sect, but she never dared to use it.
[System: Yes, yes, but are you sure? 】
Ning Chu held the medicine bottle in his hand tightly, his eyes firm and stupid, "I'm sure."
Otherwise, she would still not be able to complete the strategy mission when her master's ruthless way ascended.
[System: That’s okay. 】
The night is as cold as water.
Ning Chu took a pot of spirit flowers and drank into He Yinzhou's cave. The cave where he practiced was as cold as him, without any feeling of home.
Hearing the footsteps, He Yinzhou, who was sitting at the table reading a book, didn't even raise his head. His slender index finger moved slightly, and the pages of the book moved without any wind.
"Master." Ning Chu opened his mouth, put the tray on the table, poured out a cup of spiritual flower drink and held it in front of him, "The spiritual flower drink brewed by my disciple myself is filled with hundreds of kinds of spiritual fruits. It is very sweet. Please try it."
He Yinzhou then raised his eyes, looked at her expressionlessly, then lowered his head and opened his thin lips lightly: "No need, I don't like sweets, you can go out."
She tightened her grip on the porcelain cup and thought angrily in her heart, how could a mouth with a temperature of 37 degrees say such cold words? It really broke her heart.
But she didn't want to give up, so she handed the cup to his lips again and said pitifully: "Master, just have a taste."
"This is the first spirit flower drink you taught me to brew a hundred and eighty-eight years ago. As you know, my disciple is a fake daughter. Everyone in the sect dislikes me, and no one wants to make friends with me."
"The only one who can say a few words to my disciple is you, Master. Do you hate me too?"
